Motorsports

Ferrari Corso Pilota

Register interest 2027 schedule

Ferrari Driving Courses

Ferrari Corso Pilota is the official driving course designed to help Ferrari owners unlock the full potential of their cars.

Develop your sports driving and learn to make full use of a Ferrari’s potential on the track.

1Programmes

The Sport, Evoluzione+ and Race courses are designed to bring out your potential. Each of these courses prepares you for the next, and ultimately to race in the Ferrari Challenge, the Prancing Horse’s single-make world series dedicated to Ferrari clients. You’ll be supervised like a Formula 1 sportsperson, with professional instructors, mental coaches and official nutritionists from Scuderia Ferrari.

Level1 of 3

Corso Pilota Sport

Learn the fundamentals of sports driving skills behind the wheel of the Ferrari 296 GTB, 296 Speciale and Ferrari 849 Testarossa on the legendary Fiorano circuit.

Corso Pilota Sport offers a complete, progressive program focused on giving participants a comprehensive understanding of sport driving techniques. The two-day course consists of a specific and exciting training program based on an exclusive, personalized teaching method, using Ferrari cars for track work and vehicle control exercises.

Up to 28 customers are divided into four groups and receive direct, engaging instruction on the most efficient driving position in the cockpit, progressive acceleration and brake control, and establishing precise driving lines through bends.

The training leads up to thrilling car control exercises that demonstrate conditions and application of power oversteer. The course also provides an excellent opportunity to become familiar with the actual performance of various Ferrari models thanks to a program that lets you experience different electronic vehicle control setups.

The practical instruction is completed by several theory sessions aimed at giving a more in-depth insight into driving technique and helping drivers analyze vehicle behavior.

Level2 of 3

Corso Pilota Evoluzione+

Continue training at the wheel of the 296 GTB, 296 Speciale and the Ferrari 849 Testarossa, and drive a Ferrari race car: the 296 Challenge.

The two-day Evoluzione+ Course divides 20 participants into groups of four and offers each the opportunity to develop their on-road Ferrari driving skills while experiencing the unique thrill of driving a 296 Challenge race car.

Driving techniques and excitement are enhanced by in-depth telemetric analysis, also based on the use of competition cars and tires. What’s more, a highly personalized teaching approach is dedicated to improving the technique and personal performance of each participant in greater detail, based on intensive use of data acquisition systems.

As its name suggests, the Evoluzione+ Course is the natural “evolution” of Ferrari Corso Pilota. By means of dynamic skill trials, the training program helps drivers adapt sports driving techniques to day-to-day situations in advanced track sessions, during which they discover the performance of road-going Ferraris and that of the 296 Challenge race car, as well as furthering their own personal limits.

Level3 of 3

Corso Pilota Race

Take part in two days of advanced driving sessions: first, get behind the wheel of the 296 GTB and 296 Speciale road cars, then increase your driving skills with the Ferrari 296 Challenge.

Ferrari Corso Pilota is completed in the Race Course, the ultimate expression of sports driving instruction dedicated to Ferrari customers. This two-day course takes the sports concepts developed in the previous two programs to their logical conclusion. Ferrari has created the Race Course to provide highly professional and technically advanced instruction in order to bring customers closer to the world of Ferrari racing.

It therefore provides in-depth instruction aimed at perfecting driving technique and maintaining constant performance over timed track sessions, as well as teaching participants how they can take part in the Ferrari Challenge professionally, safely and competitively. The dynamic program is based on track driving sessions with the 296 Challenge.

Chronometric and telemetric assessment is used to help participants gain familiarity with basic racing techniques, such as starting and overtaking, the procedures at various stages of a race, car setup methods, and race rules and regulations. The Race Course therefore offers a highly exciting and professional experience necessary to become a real Ferrari racing driver.

2Activity

Unleash all your potential

The track is the ideal environment for enjoying all the performance of a Ferrari in complete safety. Experience high speeds on long straights and handle the traction coming out of a tight turn. During the course sessions, you’ll learn to drive with the right technique, fully exploiting the power of the engine and capacity of the braking system and vehicle dynamics.

Immerse yourself in the circuit

Familiarise yourself with the car, discover how it behaves at every point of the course and learn track driving techniques from a professional driver. The AR headsets will give you an immersive experience of the circuit to learn the driving lines to take and understand how load transfers affect driving.

Sports driving

Take to the track and unleash the car’s potential. There will be a certified instructor in the passenger seat who will teach you techniques like braking, throttle management coming out of a turn or counter-steering, helping you to improve lap after lap.

See the track with a new point of view

Experience the learning techniques used by professional drivers. Your instructor will be able to use Eye Tracking to see where you look while driving, giving you precise, specific advice.

Stay in control

Speed doesn’t count without technique. Refine it on the precision courses and learn to handle the car in the wet with low grip as well. At the end of the course, challenge the skills of the other drivers.

3Off-track activities

The training of a professional driver

Med-Ex, Scuderia Ferrari’s official medical partner, will supervise you with a series of collateral activities before and after track driving, so you’re always in peak condition. A trainer, physiotherapist and mental coach will be available to you to improve your physical and mental well-being, while a nutritionist will help you put together lunches characterised by a balance of protein, fat and carbohydrates.

Morning warm-up with targeted upper body exercises (arms, shoulders, neck). Individual sessions with a personal trainer, stretching and posture exercises. Reflex and reaction time training.

Recovery session with a physiotherapist after track driving. Targeted treatments to relieve muscular tension, improve flexibility, reduce fatigue and aid the body’s recovery.

Controlled breathing exercises and stress management with a sport psychologist. Short sessions focused on the mind to improve concentration.

4The car

Drive the difference

Our Corso Pilota Sport allows you to experience two icons of Ferrari speed and elegance from behind the wheel. From the surprising agility of the 296 GTB and the driving thrills of the 296 Speciale, to the Ferrari 849 Testarossa: a twin-turbo V8 paired with three electric motors delivers a combined output of 1,050 CV, engineered for maximum on-track performance.

The car1 of 3

296 GTB. 830 HP of pure entertainment

Here you are at the wheel of the 296 GTB. Compact, responsive and marked by functional aerodynamics, the car represents the evolution of the sports berlinetta to a mid-rear engine: a V6 perfectly matched with the electric motor.

On request, you can also feel the thrill of the V12 on the road: the tradition of the GTs of the fifties and sixties awaits you at the wheel of the Ferrari 12Cilindri.

The car2 of 3

296 Speciale. New driving thrills

The extraboost control strategy leverages the powertrain’s limits to deliver a peak boost at corner exit and reduce lap times. The heart of the powertrain is a 120‑degree V6 internal‑combustion engine paired with a plug‑in electric motor, delivering 880 CV.

The car3 of 3

Ferrari 849 Testarossa: towards the future

An evolution of the SF90 Stradale, the Ferrari 849 Testarossa is designed for uncompromising performance: its mid-mounted V8 engine, paired with three electric motors, delivers over 1,050 CV. Active aerodynamics ensure high downforce and maximum stability at high speed, while its proportions echo the sport prototypes of the 1970s.

5Fiorano

The track where legends are born

You will drive at a cult Prancing Horse location: the Fiorano Circuit.

Enzo Ferrari had this circuit built, the same track where Scuderia Ferrari trained and where the cars are now developed, to test the behaviour of his cars.

Corso Pilota in Italy runs at Fiorano. The 2027 North America courses are in the schedule.

Location
Fiorano
Inaugurated
1972
Length of circuit
3021m
Best lap time
1' 17”309

A Ferrari welcome

The Fiorano Circuit is a symbolic location that unites history, automotive tradition and the pursuit of perfection. For two days, you’ll breathe in the culture of sports driving, living out the legend of the Prancing Horse in every detail.

The Ferrari experience opens its doors

The elegant Hospitality area, closed to the public, hosts Ferrari Experiences: it’s where you will be able to have lunch during the course.

The meeting of past, present and future

Casa Ferrari can be found at the heart of the Fiorano Circuit factory. Characterised by rural architecture, with iconic white bricks and red windows, it is where Enzo Ferrari himself worked, consulted the drivers and attended test sessions. His study is still diligently preserved.
